scenes.name: The clock, not the output
lines: Six and twelve go into the same machine. Both come back unchanged.
6 和 12 输入同一台机器，两个数都原样留下。
But six takes five steps, while twelve takes thirteen. The extra zero is the clue.
但 6 要走五步，12 要走十三步。多出来的那个零就是线索。

scenes.name: Five steps on the tape
lines: Start at the right edge of six. Pass its zero and turn at the first one.
从 6 的最右端起步。经过零，在遇到第一个 1 时折返。
Back at the edge, mark the zero with a one and make the same trip again.
回到边缘，把零暂时标记成 1，再走一遍。
On the second return, erase the mark and exit. That last move counts.
第二次返回时擦去标记并出界。最后这一步也计数。

scenes.name: The restoring recurrence
lines: Each extra zero makes the machine run the smaller block twice: once before the mark, once after.
每多一个零，机器就把小一阶的区块走两遍：标记前一次，标记后一次。
Add the three single moves. The times are one, five, thirteen, twenty-nine. Add three, and they double each time.
再加三个单步，步数是 1、5、13、29。每项加三，就正好逐次翻倍。

scenes.name: The same answer from divisors
lines: Bala's signed divisor sum cancels away everything except powers of two. For twelve, only one, two, and four survive.
Bala 的带符号除数和会抵消二的幂以外的项。对 12，仅 1、2、4 留下。
Their contributions are one, four, and eight. That is thirteen, the same as the machine.
三项分别贡献 1、4、8，总和十三，恰和机器步数相同。

scenes.name: One feature controls both
lines: For every positive input, both calculations depend only on its trailing zeros. Zero itself has no first one, and never exits.
对每个正输入，两种计算都只取决于末尾零的个数。零本身没有第一个 1，所以永不出界。
